canonical_source.title: SESSION CONTEXT FIELD — SCF Capsule Environmental Awareness Specification
canonical_source.author: Amul Bham

reconciliations: Kernel Track schema advances monotonically from v3.8 to v3.9; source schema v3.5 remains provenance
KRONOS fires after SCF but does not read SCF or accept gate influence from it
Capsule total is frozen from the KV-Scribe entry snapshot and is not retroactively rewritten
Thread is copied from SESSION_THREAD or the latest sealed master-capsule name; SCF never generates a summary
CAP-000 initializes #mode_literal so the required mode callout is defined from T1
Five callouts are mandatory; the separately specified transition segment is conditional and structurally absent when no change occurred
CAP-014-SCF satisfies and activates Dynamic Vector Trigger T3
